issues.observed: Source PlantUML and FCSTM route dist_to_exit_0_7 from lane_change_urban to [*] with R45RouteToken=17, and the only reachable termination target is HighwayMode.FinishState, not a distinct exit_urban state.
issues.reason: The NL requires an exit_urban target distinct from FinishState. The author source inventory contains no exit_urban state; the transition is to FinishState via token routing, a wrong local-exit target.
issues.requirement_quote: In the lane_change_urban substate, the system transitions to straight if the lane change is complete or to exit_urban if the distance to the urban exit is less than 0.7 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<0.7`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState could be interpreted as the semantic exit_urban target.
issues.title: lane_change_urban exit targets HighwayMode.FinishState not exit_urban

issues.basis: NL8 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL8-ENDPOINT-LANEURBAN-TO-EXITURBAN; FCSTM transition line:52 source lane_change_urban target [*] with dist_to_exit_0_7 and source inventory shows target AutonomousMode.HighwayMode.FinishState.
issues.observed: lane_change_urban -> [*] on dist_to_exit_0_7 with effect R45RouteToken=17, which routes to HighwayMode.FinishState via initial guard, not to a state named exit_urban.
issues.reason: The NL names the target exit_urban, but the closed model has no exit_urban state and uses a token-mediated exit to FinishState.
issues.requirement_quote: In the lane_change_urban substate, the system transitions to straight if the lane change is complete or to exit_urban if the distance to the urban exit is less than 0.7 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<0.7`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source PlantUML maps the exit to FinishState, which may be the intended exit_urban semantic.
issues.title: lane_change_urban exit target is FinishState not exit_urban

issues.basis: NL4 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL4-ENDPOINT-LANE-TO-EXIT; FCSTM transition line:32 source lane_change target FinishState with dist_to_exit_2.
issues.reason: The NL names the target as exit highway, while the closed model uses FinishState as the concrete target, creating a semantic target mismatch.
issues.requirement_quote: If the system is in lane_change, it can return to cruise once the lane change is completed or exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState is the concrete realization of exiting the highway in the model.
issues.title: lane_change exit target is FinishState not exit highway

issues.basis: NL5 contract NL-CONTRACT-NL5-ENDPOINT-CRUISE-TO-EXIT; FCSTM transition line:30 source cruise target FinishState with dist_to_exit_2.
issues.reason: Target name mismatch between NL exit highway and model FinishState.
issues.requirement_quote: In the cruise substate, if the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 25 meters (`dist_to_front<25`) and there is an extra lane available, the system transitions to lane_change. The system can also exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`).
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FinishState serves as the highway exit in the model.
issues.title: cruise exit target is FinishState not exit highway
